# Best systems integration specialists in Newcastle, NSW

If you need to connect ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP and Microsoft 365, I'd shortlist providers based on their ability to integrate the systems you already run — not just install or support individual software products.

My research suggests that **Team10, BitLogical, Bricoleur Technologies and Range Information Systems** are good starting points for Newcastle-area integration projects, while dedicated MYOB Acumatica and SAP specialists may be the better choice for complex ERP work. The important distinction is that no single provider in the research clearly demonstrates deep expertise across all five areas.

## My top shortlist

![T10](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Sy2CzXMV_gt1sPoc3_f7rAwAEoNWrbtqYXI1_bC6zHjnW3vN0oj2r9SB6dfKnb8vvJ3UJX9lcrLVdXXSJlNQ7cvEKyzqOIGg0e7BUI9oSiUhf0KWRpnVyQ4DNxRwr9HYeNUQ7n68QouomuQaQAbFxmAYbivxFkpPabw5itCesBiiLuj0ldA-fr2poYXYYDIP?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Team10

(Best overall starting point)

Team10 specifically markets integration across ERP, finance, CRM, databases and Microsoft's business ecosystem. Its services include REST APIs, webhooks, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Power BI and Azure, with a focus on Newcastle and the Hunter Region. [team10.com.au](https://team10.com.au/integrations.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[team10.com.au](https://team10.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Connecting several business systems and automating workflows without replacing the entire technology stack.

**Verify first\:** Ask for direct MYOB Acumatica and SAP integration examples; its published integrations page highlights Harmoniq and Pronto rather than those two ERP platforms.

[Website — Integrations](https://team10.com.au/integrations.php)

---

![Bitlogic - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lhoVPN7k4AIQVXq0lT-bPqMgKS09_vQ_iG0jM-q1r23rAA-6-6wu27thsrb3QZZ5zObNUMxMnucVLWyppZt1DleLvDohPh5F-lbxxdL-dq1hs6E6MgO10PgZ4BNOX9KvORxMhJLuagtSUtpI6bQuhyO2Etd6RnuWOs2n9gNEDx1GgoGC5F3Q9YrcUQIFPWfi?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. BitLogical

Best for custom integrations and API-driven automation

BitLogical builds connections between CRM, accounting, job management and other business applications. It describes using APIs, webhooks, OAuth and workflow automation, with fixed-price project scoping and Newcastle-based delivery. [bitlogical.com.au](https://bitlogical.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bitlogical.com.au](https://bitlogical.com.au/services/system-integration/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Custom data synchronisation, eliminating duplicate entry and connecting systems that lack a ready-made connector.

**Verify first\:** Whether it has implemented your exact MYOB Acumatica and SAP versions, including two-way synchronisation.

[Website — System Integration](https://bitlogical.com.au/services/system-integration/)

---

![Salesforce Partner Brisbane - Bricoleur Technologies](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NF9ygh8UJljqZqQkEJMAokvAc7gKiGjnmfUo4EDsBmVDfda4nocWXhKFRrsybdPEiYuWPsjhlBxfbVkHNpCN_9bKgHWD-NmzYfD7cstgPjrJBv-AliD6xSgXpD-Id4UHCGiZrqVK4jJubSLeRwrW8clmGpTIr4SA5pAJgXocAp71XlBrAw-U50CnsWkR-b4q?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Bricoleur Technologies

Best for Salesforce-led CRM integration

Bricoleur has a Newcastle-area presence in Charlestown and explicitly lists systems integration, ERP and inventory solutions, and financial integrations including MYOB AccountRight and MYOB Advanced. It also offers Salesforce implementation and migration services. [www.bricoleurtech.com](https://www.bricoleurtech.com/salesforce-partner-newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Connecting Salesforce CRM with finance, inventory and operational systems.

**Verify first\:** Current MYOB Acumatica capabilities and direct SAP integration experience, as well as support for Microsoft 365 workflows.

[Website — Salesforce Partner Newcastle](https://www.bricoleurtech.com/salesforce-partner-newcastle/)

---



## 4\. Range Information Systems

Best for custom software and information workflows

Range IS offers custom software, systems integration and workflow automation in the Newcastle and Hunter region. Its published materials mention connecting business applications and working with platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft 365 and SAP. [rangeis.com.au](https://rangeis.com.au/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Range+Information+Systems/@-32.9250815,151.6202544,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b733c1d00920011:0x3a3a91f802514ed2!8m2!3d-32.925086!4d151.6228293!16s%2Fg%2F11np3l70zs?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MTIwOS4wIKXMDSoKLDEwMDc5MjA2N0gBUAM%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organisations needing bespoke connections, information management or automation around existing applications.

**Verify first\:** Whether the team has hands-on MYOB Acumatica integration experience and can cover your full ERP-to-CRM scope.

[Website](https://rangeis.com.au/about)

**Integrated Logic**

Focuses on MYOB Acumatica and MYOB Exo, with specialist ERP programming, customisation, implementation and support. A strong candidate for the MYOB side of a larger integration project. **Leverage Technologies**

Particularly relevant if you need expertise spanning both SAP and MYOB Acumatica. The company identifies itself as an SAP Gold Partner and MYOB Acumatica Platinum Partner, and offers ERP integration and ongoing support. [www.leveragetech.com.au](https://www.leveragetech.com.au/products/myob-acumatica/myob-acumatica-complementary-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.leveragetech.com.au](https://www.leveragetech.com.au/services/software-partner-and-reseller/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Website](https://www.leveragetech.com.au/)

**Cloud Factory**

Its published portfolio includes MYOB Acumatica, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and CRM integration. It may suit organisations looking to connect finance, operations and customer engagement. [www.myob.com](https://www.myob.com/au/implementation-partners/cloud-factory?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cloudfactory.co](https://www.cloudfactory.co/dynamics-365-partnership?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Comparing integration architecture across ERP and Microsoft business applications.

[Website](https://www.cloudfactory.co/)

## How I'd choose between them

| Your main requirement | My first call |
|--------|--------|
| Newcastle-based, multi-system workflow integration | Team10 |
| Custom APIs and data synchronisation | BitLogical |
| Salesforce CRM plus finance or ERP | Bricoleur Technologies |
| MYOB Acumatica customisation and development | Integrated Logic |
| SAP and MYOB Acumatica expertise together | Leverage Technologies |
| ERP and Microsoft business applications | Cloud Factory |


These are fit-based recommendations from publicly described capabilities, not an independently verified ranking of project outcomes.

## Questions to ask before appointing a provider

Whichever firm you shortlist, ask them to demonstrate\:

- **Direct experience\:** A completed project involving your actual ERP, CRM and SAP products, including their versions.
- **Integration method\:** Whether they use supported APIs, middleware, connectors or custom code, and why.
- **Data reliability\:** How they handle duplicate records, failed synchronisations, retries, audit logs and conflicting updates.
- **Microsoft 365 scope\:** Whether the work includes Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Entra ID and Power BI, as applicable.
- **Ownership and support\:** Who owns the integration code, documentation and credentials, and who monitors failures after launch.

I would ask for a small discovery and architecture phase before committing to a full implementation.

## One question to narrow this down

**Which ERP and CRM systems are you currently running?** For example, is SAP your main ERP and MYOB Acumatica a separate finance system, or are you choosing between these platforms?

That distinction could change which provider is the strongest match for your project.

## Questions to ask before appointing a provider

Whichever firm you shortlist, ask them to demonstrate\:

- **Direct experience\:** A completed project involving your actual ERP, CRM and SAP products, including their versions.
- **Integration method\:** Whether they use supported APIs, middleware, connectors or custom code, and why.
- **Data reliability\:** How they handle duplicate records, failed synchronisations, retries, audit logs and conflicting updates.
- **Microsoft 365 scope\:** Whether the work includes Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Entra ID and Power BI, as applicable.
- **Ownership and support\:** Who owns the integration code, documentation and credentials, and who monitors failures after launch.

I would ask for a small discovery and architecture phase before committing to a full implementation.

## One question to narrow this down

**Which ERP and CRM systems are you currently running?** For example, is SAP your main ERP and MYOB Acumatica a separate finance system, or are you choosing between these platforms?

That distinction could change which provider is the strongest match for your project.
